text:
Alex K.: quick heads-up — I'm doing the overnight swap at 00:00 UTC. I need to step away for a short offline window ~00:30-01:00 to handle an urgent personal thing. If anyone's available to be primary for that 30m window pls shout. If not I can extend to 01:30 but would prefer not to.

Priya P.: I can take primary from 00:30-01:00. Will be reachable via phone. What services are highest risk for that window?

Alex K.: thanks!! Risk list: svc-api (customer-facing), embed-indexer, and batch-transcoder. svc-api had intermittent 5xx spikes earlier today, so watch for end-user error rate and elevated latency.

Oncall Bot: INCIDENT BOT: Note — scheduled batch-maintenance at 00:45 UTC in us-west region (non-prod). No automatic pages expected.

Jordan L.: @Priya P. TY. Reminder: paging rules — per runbook: page primary for P1/P0. If no ack within 2m, escalate to secondary. If still unacked after 5m escalate to Ops Lead. Notify customer-success if customer-visible degradation >5min.

Priya P.: got it. Can someone paste the quick escalation numbers? I don't have them memorized.

Sam: quick list — Primary (on-call) -> Secondary (on-call-backup) -> Ops Lead -> Engineering Director. Phone numbers are in the roster doc but shortflow for emergency: Ops Lead = +1-555-0101, Eng Dir = +1-555-0202. Pagerduty escalation is configured 2m -> 5m -> 10m by default.

Alex K.: adding a tiny checklist for the swap so Priya has context:
1) Check /status and svc-api /healthz
2) If 5xx spike, run quick rollback script or switch to canary fallback
3) If DB is slow, follow rdb-runbook + contact DB pager
4) If network/region fail, failover to us-east policy (see routing runbook)

Alex K.: Quick commands:
```
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}\n" https://svc-api.internal/healthz
kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/svc-api --to-revision=HEAD-1
/pager acknowledge
/pager escalate --to "Ops Lead"
```

Priya P.: thanks for the checklist. One question — in the case of heavy customer impact (multiple tenants affected) do we page CSMs immediately or wait 10 minutes per notify policy?

Jordan L.: per policy: for P1 with customer impact >= single enterprise tenant, page CSMs immediate after triage confirmation. For broad disruption (multi-tenant >5% error rate) escalate to CSM + Exec comms owner within 10 min. Always put note in #incidents channel with preliminary impact score.

Priya P.: noted. I'll accept primary at 00:30. I'll set my status and phone on. Alex, ping me if you can't make it to 01:30 and we can extend.

Oncall Bot: DEPLOY BOT: prod deploy svc-api started at 00:33 UTC by ci-bot (dc-3). Watch for increased 502s.

Sam: small reminder about escalation etiquette:
- First page: short context + runbook pointer + what you've tried
- If escalating, include logs link and recent error-rate numbers
- If paging Ops Lead, include whether auto-fallback attempted

Priya P.: understood. I'll use the template: "PAGER: svc-api increased 5xx from 0.2% -> 6% since 00:29 UTC. Tried restart + rollback attempt queued. Need assistance with DB tracing. Paging Primary"

Alex K.: perfect. Also if you see repeated false positives (noise) during the deploy, annotate and mute alerts for the deploy window per alert-squelch runbook so we don't spam.

Jordan L.: small procedural note — coverage gaps policy: if primary plans to be unreachable for >15m, they must document swap in #eng-oncall and tag secondary + ops-lead. For <15m it's a courtesy handoff. This thread satisfies documentation.

Priya P.: I'll post a 00:30 check-in message in this thread when I take over.

(Oncall Bot): PAGER: svc-api alert — 502 spike at 00:37 UTC. Severity: P1. Trigger: 5xx rate >5% over 1m.

Priya P.: ACK — taking primary. Investigating. First glance: frontends showing increased 502s, backend pool saturating. Running probe now.

Sam: If you need to escalate to Ops Lead, mention "capacity saturation" and include `top`/`dmesg` if kernel OOM suspected.

Priya P.: running `kubectl top pods -n prod | grep svc-api` now. CPU spiking on replica-2. Scaling up 2 replicas as a mitigation. Will monitor.

Alex K.: thanks for stepping in. If scaling doesn't help within 3 min, escalate per the 2m/5m windows.

Priya P.: scaling showed improvement in latency at 00:41. 5xx rate dropping to 1.2%. I'll keep monitoring for 15m then hand back. Posting a short postmortem note after handback with root-cause start/stop times.

Jordan L.: beautiful — please add whether autoscaler behaved as expected and any anomalies in metrics ingestion. That helps Optimize folks tune batching/scale config.

Priya P.: will do. Handoff note planned for 00:55 with final metrics.

Alex K.: thanks everyone — appreciate the quick coordination. Priya, I'll confirm you're primary in #ops-status and then log the swap in the rota doc.

(Oncall Bot): NOTE: Thread archived by Oncall Bot at 00:58 UTC (handshake: primary switched).
